note: Carousel no. 17 quotes every date and every award number it prints, so the aggregates here are counting words rather than arithmetic. Each is declared against the exact string the frame renders. NO INTERVAL between any two dates is computed anywhere in this deck, and that omission is declared at the end of this file rather than left to be noticed.

deliberately_not_computed.what: the interval between the Frontera award's expiration on 02/28/2025 and the closing date of October 1st, 2026
deliberately_not_computed.why: No source performs it. The fact-checker rejected it explicitly and the deck never sets those two dates beside each other in a way that invites the subtraction.

deliberately_not_computed.what: any count of ports, cavities, punched holes or racks drawn on any frame
deliberately_not_computed.why: Every repeated element in this deck runs off the frame edges with no boundary and no total, by structural law 5, precisely so no count is readable. There is no published queue depth and the deck may not imply one.

deliberately_not_computed.what: the number of days a reader has left before October 1st, 2026
deliberately_not_computed.why: It would be true for one day and wrong on every other day the post is read.
